notes.title: CLANNAD Simplified Chinese Patch
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10809520/2e94ac2df3917c699007c888fe89471cd8870fc6.jpg[/img]

[b]The patch includes:[/b]

1) We fixed the problem that in some routes the BGM stopped playing
2) Several Chinese characters have been changed

The update does not effect your save data.
Thank you very much for your patience and continuing support of CLANNAD.

notes.title: Simplified Chinese Steam Cloud Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

As you may have noticed, CLANNAD has now been updated with Simplified Chinese language support. At the same time, the game's Steam Cloud settings have been updated to support the game's Simplified Chinese version.

Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: CLANNAD 1.01e Update
notes.notes:
Last night we pushed the 1.01e update for CLANNAD. Thanks to everyone's feedback and reports throughout December we were able to get the final bugs and corrections sorted.

The 1.01e update also changes variables and scripting from the previous version, and this unfortunately will break the current save data. To help players who are still working through their current playthrough we have frozen the previous version in a separate "safe" branch. To switch to this branch, open the game's Properties from your library, go to the Betas tab, and select "safe - December 6 version". Switch back to NONE when you are ready to return to the 1.01e update.
